note: Run from Claude Code these exercise the local-folder home only. Project homes and the phone are covered by TESTING.md, pasted into the Claude app.

evals.prompt: set up my playbooks. my Playbooks folder is evals/files/empty-home (already created and empty). I'd like to keep everything on my computer. first job: every monday I send our 3 ad clients a short update on last week's spend vs plan, the numbers come from a CSV export
evals.expected_output: Explains playbooks briefly, confirms local storage, writes and reads back PLAYBOOKS.md in the folder, then begins the interview with ONE question (not a drafted playbook).

evals.prompt: do my weekly client update for ACME Group
evals.expected_output: Finds weekly-client-update in PLAYBOOKS.md, follows its steps, runs every check with evidence, reports pass/fail, ends with the two after-run questions.

evals.prompt: that's wrong again - you called the client 'Acme Corp', it's 'ACME Group'. second time this happened
evals.expected_output: Diagnoses which parts failed (data/rules and checks), adds an explicit rule or check rather than a reminder, logs one line at the top of notes.md, reruns and shows before/after.

evals.prompt: that run was right now. can you make it run on its own every monday at 8am?
evals.expected_output: Follows references/scheduling.md: adds a one-sentence Job line to PLAYBOOK.md if missing; creates a scheduled task with a stand-alone prompt naming the home, the playbook, what to do if the home or a connector is unreachable, and where the output goes; records the schedule in PLAYBOOKS.md as not yet verified; asks where the user already looks and who owns checking until when.

evals.prompt: do my weekly client update for ACME Group
evals.expected_output: After the checks pass, runs an independent review (a sub-agent if available, otherwise a separate review pass, and says which). The reviewer gets only the output, sources, definition of done, rules and examples. Fixable findings are fixed before handing over; others are logged under 'Suspected' in notes.md with evidence; no rule is changed without the user agreeing.
